validity.value: Must be recent; 3 passport-size photographs required per application

cross_verification.note_en: Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (mfa.gov.af) is the current de facto governing authority's official passport-issuing body; the Embassy of Afghanistan in Islamabad page is a subdomain of this ministry. Size (4×4.5cm) and background (white) match the current DB values exactly — no conflict. Detailed composition rules (head height ratio, expression, glasses, headwear incl. hijab requirement for women, ears visibility) are frequently cited by third-party passport-photo vendor sites but could not be confirmed on an official .gov.af page within this research pass, so they are left unverified rather than sourced to non-official sites.
